assertions.name: probe_6d_partitions_enumerated_scope_only
assertions.source: Scoping probe: enumerates the 3 partitions of n=3 (proton braid 𝓑₃ Wedderburn blocks): (3), (2,1), (1,1,1) with correct dimensions d_λ = 1, 2, 1. y_λ(q_0) are explicit 'pending pyhecke extraction' placeholders — NOT computed here (earlier guessed closed forms were removed; they failed the dim_q identity). Full per-block c_k extraction is future work.

description: Probe 6.d (scoping form): enumerates partitions of n=3 for the proton braid 𝓑₃, computes Wenzl weights y_λ(q_0) at substrate, and scopes the Wedderburn-block decomposition hypothesis. Full per-block c_k decomposition requires Hoefsmit-rep extraction infra not built here.

future_work.y_lambda_classical_anchors: At q=1 the Wenzl weights specialize to S_3: y_(2,1)(1)=1/3, y_(3)(1)=y_(1,1,1)(1)=1/6 (standard d_λ/n! normalization). Verification anchors for the pending q-dependent extraction.
